Yellow.idle: Grazes and shoulders through the undergrowth in a slow, heavy patrol, rarely breaking into a run unless you get close.
Yellow.when_locked: Bolts in short, lumbering bursts rather than a clean sprint - it can't outrun you, so it barrels through cover and obstacles, crashing off anything in its path and zig-zagging clumsily whenever you close the gap.

Red.idle: Bounces and darts between patches of cover in short hops, always poised to spring away at the first sign of you.
Red.when_locked: Explodes into frantic, erratic zig-zag leaps the instant the lock lands, changing direction on every bound to spoil your pounce timing.

Blue.idle: Keeps to open sightlines, drifting at a wary distance and watching rather than grazing.
Blue.when_locked: Panics and flees in a straight zig-zag, trying to put obstacles or distance between itself and your facing cone, doubling back if it gets cornered.

Purple.idle: Moves in short, cautious stretches between patches of cover, pausing often to check what's nearby.
Purple.when_locked: Weaves through the nearest cover in tight zig-zags, ducking behind obstacles and doubling back to break your line of sight.

Grey.idle: Wanders with an unusually confident, unhurried gait for prey, favouring open ground over cover.
Grey.when_locked: Hesitates a beat before bolting, then flees in wide zig-zag arcs, shouldering through smaller creatures that get in its way.

grazers.idle: Grazes in the open, oblivious to everything but the ground in front of it, never watching for you.
grazers.when_locked: Bolts the instant the lock lands, sprinting flat-out in a straight line for open ground - no zig-zag, no doubling back, no fighting back, just flight.

Yellow.territory: Holds a fixed patch of its pocket and doesn't wander from it, squaring up to face you the moment you cross into its range rather than giving ground.
Yellow.wind_up: Plants itself and squares its whole body toward you, a long, visible brace before it closes the last distance and pounces - the biggest, slowest-committing tell in the pocket, and murderous if you walk into it anyway.

Red.territory: Prowls a tight loop at the heart of its pocket, closing distance the instant you're inside its range instead of waiting for you to approach.
Red.wind_up: Coils low and holds it, then covers the remaining ground in one committed, explosive leap the moment the wind-up ends.

Blue.territory: Holds well back at the edge of its range, repositioning to keep you inside its facing cone rather than closing in.
Blue.wind_up: Freezes and levels its whole body at you from far outside the range most creatures would need - the wind-up is long, but it starts from a distance you won't see coming.

Purple.territory: Slips between the pocket's cover, holding its range loosely and repositioning rather than standing still.
Purple.wind_up: Feints a shift in direction before settling into its wind-up, and its neighbours peel off toward you the moment it locks on.

Grey.territory: Holds the centre of its pocket like it owns the ground, and doesn't give an inch of range when you close in.
Grey.wind_up: Rises up before it winds up, and everything else nearby turns to converge on you the instant it does.

Fins.arena: Found in a deep marsh hollow, patrolling the open water at its centre rather than the banks.
Fins.opening: The moment you commit to the fight, the hollow's other occupants start converging on your position from the surrounding reeds and channels.
Fins.wind_up: Rears back in the water and holds, a full-bodied brace before it surges at you - it does not break off and does not flee, no matter how the fight goes.

Claws.arena: Holds a rocky outcrop, perched above the surrounding slopes rather than patrolling at ground level.
Claws.opening: Committing to the fight draws the outcrop's other occupants up the rocks toward you from every side.
Claws.wind_up: Digs in and braces against the rock before launching down at you - it stands its ground through the whole exchange and never turns to run.

Coat.arena: Holds the mountain foothills below the cold line, patrolling a fixed stretch rather than roaming it.
Coat.opening: Engaging it brings the foothills' other grazer-hunters closing in from the slopes around you.
Coat.wind_up: Squares up and holds its ground through a long brace before charging - it fights the whole exchange out and never bolts.

Heat.arena: Holds a volcanic vent along the shore, never drifting far from the seam it lives on.
Heat.opening: Starting the fight draws the vent's other occupants in from across the shore to converge on you.
Heat.wind_up: Glows brighter along its seam as it winds up, holding the brace until it commits to the pounce - it never breaks and run, fighting to the end.

Yellow.emergence: At the warning, the lair's den lights and the ground trembles as an audio cue rises - then, after a short grace period, the Yellow Alpha bursts out and starts hunting you across the biome.
Yellow.hunt: It closes on you at a flat, relentless pace no amount of running shakes - every prey and grazer in the biome bolts for the edges the instant it wakes, and the ground stays empty while it lives.
Yellow.tell: Squares its whole body toward you and holds a long, heavy brace before it closes and slams down - the biggest tell of any hunter you've faced, and the hardest hit.

Red.emergence: The lair lights up and the ground shakes at the warning, and after the grace period the Red Alpha erupts and starts hunting you across the biome.
Red.hunt: It never stops closing, no matter how far or fast you run, and the biome around you has already emptied - prey and grazers fled the instant it woke.
Red.tell: Coils low for a beat before covering huge ground in a single committed leap - miss the window to punish the wind-up and it's already on you.

Blue.emergence: Den lights and trembling ground announce the warning, and once the grace period passes the Blue Alpha comes hunting you across the biome.
Blue.hunt: It keeps its distance and stalks your position from range, closing only enough to keep you in its cone, and the biome has already gone quiet around you.
Blue.tell: Freezes and locks its whole body toward you from far outside normal range, holding the pose through a long wind-up before it pounces the distance closed.

Purple.emergence: The ground trembles and the lair lights at the warning; after the grace period the Purple Alpha slips out hunting you across the biome.
Purple.hunt: It repositions constantly rather than charging straight in, closing the gap in short bursts, while the emptied biome offers nowhere to restock on healing.
Purple.tell: Feints a shift in direction, settles into its brace, and holds it before darting the last distance to pounce.

Grey.emergence: Den lights, trembling ground and the rising cue mark the warning; when the grace period ends the Grey Alpha emerges hunting you across the biome.
Grey.hunt: It closes on you with the same relentless flat pace as every Alpha, strong on every axis at once, in a biome already emptied of everything that could have healed you.
Grey.tell: Rises up and holds through a long, total-body brace before it closes and pounces with everything it has.

apex.emergence: It lies dormant and unseen in the Ascension domain, never stirring for anything less - the instant your Bestiary record crosses its threshold, wherever you are and whatever you're doing, even mid-hunt for another form, it wakes.
apex.hunt: Once awake it hunts you across the whole Ascension domain rather than any one corner of it - there is no safe stretch of the summit left once it is moving, and it does not return to dormancy while you're alive.
apex.tell: Commits to a slower, heavier wind-up than anything else in the game before its pounce - hold your ground through it and punish it like any other, but walk away unpunished and it simply keeps coming.
